decisions.reason: The FAQ still states that five Big Block prizes are drawn every 50,000 sales, which conflicts with the new one-prize-per-10,000-sales rule.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I just thought of something.... I believe we should adjust the block prizes to
- Small = 1 x $500 every 100 sales.
- Big = 1 x $10,000 every 10,000 sales.

The same net $ amount would still be given away, but this would create a smoother, cleaner, clearer, and more consistent flow of winners

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + tickets are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you Small & Big Block prize tickets for the current blocks. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales. Big Block: 1 × $10,000 awarded every 10,000 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click whenever you're ready.

decisions.reason: The source Big Block Event does not change the independently modeled Small Block mechanism; the message's Small Block clause already has its own same-message Event.
Changing the Big Block winner count and draw frequency does not alter the Chainlink VRF selection method, ticket weighting, fairness, or verification behavior.
The number and frequency of Big Block winners do not change the requirement to announce winners on the Winners page.
The Big Block prize adjustment neither resolves the automatic-versus-manual delivery ambiguity nor changes the existing claim action or location.
The source changes the Big Block draw size and trigger, not how tickets are issued, who receives them, or their draw-cycle behavior.
Message 158 does not change or remove Aave yield generation; the later statement about Aave cannot be used at this source-event cutoff.
The mint price, founder share, referral commission, and prize-pool destinations remain unchanged; the client explicitly preserves the same net giveaway amount.
Big Block tickets and their metadata counter remain in use, so changing the draw frequency and winner count does not alter the stored metadata attributes.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, or allocation of Small and Big Block tickets.
The Big Block prize adjustment does not change the $5 referral commission, its trigger, recipient, timing, or payout behavior.
